candidate.definition_en: Used to emphasize that you mean exactly what you are saying and nothing more.
candidate.explanation_ar: يعني 'فقط' أو 'بس'.. بتستخدمها لما تحب تقلل من حجم أو أهمية حاجة.

senses.definition_en: Used to emphasize that you mean exactly what you are saying and nothing more.
senses.definition_ar: فقط أو مجرد شيء بسيط بدون زيادة
examples: I am merely trying to help.
We are merely suggesting a different approach.
He said nothing, merely smiled and walked away.
